senses.gloss: m. (בוג dial. for בוק, cmp. בקע) valley, plain; (= h. בִּקְעָה) a group of fields belonging to several owners, rural community.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 29a:11">B. Bath. 29ᵃ</cite> one single field <he>בכוליה בא׳</he> (Ms. H. a. O. <he>בכולֵה</he>) in the whole plain.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 22b:9">B. Mets. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳ בארעא וכ׳</he> we need not presume an entire plain to be the property of minors; a. e.—Pl. <he>בָּאגֵי</he>, <he>בָּגֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 8b">Pes. 8ᵇ</cite> those students <he>דדיירי בב׳</he> that are lodged in the rural districts (and come to town for their studies).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 113b:15">B. Kam. 113ᵇ</cite> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. for diff. vers.).
